title: Unified marketplace listing refresh and launch sprint
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: prepare and execute synchronized listing updates across AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and Google Cloud Marketplace to match Redwood Inference's latest product capabilities, pricing bundles, and compliance attestations for the Q1 launch.

Scope: refresh listing copy, screenshots and architecture diagrams; update SKU/pricing mapping for hosted/dedicated/private offerings; confirm legal/compliance assets (SOC2, DPA links, data residency options); coordinate release notes and in-console banners; validate billing and entitlements integrations for each marketplace.

Out of scope for this ticket: full localization beyond EN-US, deep integrations with reseller partner portals (handled in separate partner tickets), backend pricing engine overhaul (ENG-4315).

Acceptance criteria: (1) All three marketplace listings have updated product descriptions and hero screenshots matching assets in the marketing drive; (2) SKU/pricing mapping for Redwood Hosted and Redwood Dedicated is published and tested end-to-end in staging marketplaces; (3) Release notes and marketplace-specific launch copy are approved by Legal, Security, and Product; (4) Console rollout banner links to marketplace docs and tracks click-throughs in Amplitude; (5) Post-launch checklist created for rollback and hotfix playbook.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1 (this ticket): finalize listing copy and creative assets, obtain Legal and Security sign-off, generate marketplace-specific SKU matrix.
- Week 2: submit listings to marketplaces in staging / private listings, coordinate with Eng to run entitlement and billing smoke tests, provide marketing with approved assets for PR and blog.
- Week 3: cut final submissions to production marketplaces, publish release notes, enable console banner and telemetry, monitor dashboards for purchase and provisioning errors.

Risks and mitigation:
- Marketplace review delays: pre-submit to each marketplace with 'early access' flag and maintain a single point of contact in vendor portals; track PR numbers.
- SKU mismatch causing failed provisioning: run synthetic end-to-end flows during staging window and validate with sample customers.
- Legal/regulatory blockers (data residency claims): escalate to security for customer-facing copy; include explicit region notes on listings.

Key contacts: Marketing (Sofia Ramos), Legal (Derrick Huang), Security (Maya Singh), Engineering Lead (Priya Desai), Partner Ops (Noah Kim).
